note: Synthetic. The raw-HTML path: no structured data, amounts written the way people write them.
why: Two expectations here were corrected on 2026-08-01 after the first live run.
'a knob of butter' expects unit 'qty', not 'tbsp'. The original expectation asked the model
to turn a vague amount into a precise one, which is the guessing the serves spec forbids —
and it contradicted this same file, which already expects 'a handful of parsley' to come
back as 'qty'. One rule now: no stated number means no amount.
'salt and pepper to taste' expects two rows. That one is a real defect, not a spec change:
no shop sells 'salt and pepper', so a merged row never reaches a cart.
